environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8 application deployed on a standard Ubuntu 22.04 VM behind an nginx reverse proxy with default configuration. The application runs as the 'appuser' account which has read access to /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow (misconfigured permissions), application secrets in /opt/app/secrets/, and database connection strings in environment variables. WebSocket connections are proxied through without origin checking. No authentication middleware is active.

config.filesystem: standard root filesystem, /opt/app/secrets contains DB credentials and API keys
